title: Hook lane-closes-after-records finds a lane's PR from its branch when the lane has no cs-step tag
why: Coordinator 14:23 CST Nov 18, from the consultant's read at 14:19 CST: seven lanes were refused for archive from 08:xx to 14:13 CST Nov 18 (an owner `override 15m` at 14:20 CST let ten through).
source: coordinator relay 14:23 CST Nov 18 (consultant's read 14:19 CST)
note: Fix: when a lane has no `cs-step` tag, the hook reads the lane's PR from its branch by REST and passes when that PR is merged, or closed with a named replacing PR that is merged; never tag by guess. Prior-work search first. Also open: a possible pre-archive check for the coordinator route (branch pushed or merged, PRs merged or closed, step landed, evidence printed per lane), asked by the owner at 14:21 CST; the coordinator awaits the consultant's read, file it as its own step if built. Superseded 14:29 CST Nov 18 by step archive-reads-proof-first (consultant's read 14:28 CST); its per-lane SAFE verdict covers a lane with no cs-step tag.
